evals.prompt: We want to create a new 1Sat collection with @1sat/actions. Can I call mintCollection and mintCollectionItem today and expect the collection overlay to list it? Show me how I would list its items.
evals.expected_output: Separates the shipped stack rules from current SDK support, warns that current collection actions lack SIGMA, and describes only optional self-hosted collection routes.
expectations: States that the current mintCollection and mintCollectionItem actions lack SIGMA and therefore do not meet collection-overlay admission
Lists the /collection/{collectionId}/items route without claiming it is enabled on api.1sat.app
Explains that the collection module is disabled by default or must be enabled and registered

evals.prompt: Can a BSV21 token be a collection member? Does the token package need collection-specific fields, and does the overlay prove the item signer matches the collection root owner? Are old AIP items accepted?
evals.expected_output: Keeps BSV21 collection-agnostic, explains the script-level composition, rejects invented signer/root authority, and states that AIP does not meet current admission.
expectations: Keeps collection-specific construction outside the generic BSV21 package
States that the shipped overlay does not compare the item signer with the collection root signer or owner
States that AIP does not satisfy the shipped overlay's SIGMA requirement

evals.prompt: I want collection items to reuse one image through an ord-fs/json dot entry. What fields actually determine whether each item is admitted, and does transferring an item change the collection index?
evals.expected_output: Treats ORDFS content as orthogonal, names nested collectionId plus valid SIGMA and one-sat inscription requirements, and explains mint-only indexing.
expectations: Explains that ORDFS content resolution is independent of collection admission
Names a one-sat inscription, collectionItem MAP with nested subTypeData.collectionId, and valid SIGMA as admission requirements
States that collection indexing is mint-only and does not follow transfers
